patch_description: Replace the degenerate all-zero construction with a deterministic maximin optimization specialized to the equilateral-triangle Heilbronn problem. Three vertices are fixed at the boundary corners, while the remaining eight points are globally searched in barycentric coordinates, which guarantees feasibility without penalty terms. The objective evaluates all 165 triples using normalized area (the determinant in barycentric coordinates equals triangle area divided by the containing triangle area). A fixed-seed differential-evolution phase provides robust global exploration, followed by SLSQP polishing with the orientation of every triple fixed locally. A deterministic fallback construction is retained if SciPy is unavailable or an optimizer failure occurs.
